sources.title: Costabel-Dauge-Nedaiasl static stability paper
sources.read_scope: Full relevant Sections 1.1-1.6, 2.1-2.4 and 3.5 proofs; references. Scalar Sections 3.1-3.4 only scanned. Rendered printed pp14 and30 inspected.
sources.verdict: Supplies prior static lattice input and normalization; does not state qualified dynamic theorem.

sources.title: OWR 43/2022 Costabel contribution
sources.read_scope: Complete printed pp2580-2582, Sections1-4 and references; surrounding report not read for priority.
sources.verdict: Dynamic stability announcement plus separate off-interval spectral open question; not full proof.

sources.title: Valenciennes 2021 slides
sources.read_scope: Relevant text of numbered slides 1-8, 10-16, 34-42; 1D material searched and scanned; physical PDF pages 26, 27, 59 rendered and read including image-only code and plot. 43 numbered slides over 62 physical pages.
sources.verdict: Dynamic extension is a conjecture on slide 41; numerical illustration and earlier static analysis.

sources.title: Nedaiasl IMU visit report 2022
sources.read_scope: Both pages read through primary-source web text; direct local URL returned HTTP 404. Raw successful web response includes the report.
sources.verdict: Names dynamic manuscript in preparation; contains no full proof.

sources.title: Padova 2023 book of abstracts
sources.read_scope: Numbered pages 4-5: complete relevant Costabel abstract and two references; the rest was not audited.
sources.verdict: Second named dynamic work announcement; no target proof.

sources.title: Costabel finite Hilbert transformation convergence
sources.read_scope: Sections 1, 2.1, 3.1-3.4 and their proofs, plus the reference list. Sections 2.2-2.3 and 4 screened rather than fully audited.
sources.verdict: 1D result only; compact-perturbation framework acknowledged; dynamic manuscript in preparation in reference 3.

sources.title: Costabel current full publications
sources.read_scope: Current publication list including every 2023-2026 entry; older entries screened.
sources.verdict: No later dynamic DDA publication listed.

sources.title: Dauge current short CV and publication list
sources.read_scope: Title and date plus full recent publication section on page 2; older bibliography screened with electronic current documentation.
sources.verdict: No later dynamic DDA publication listed.

sources.title: Current arXiv author searches
sources.read_scope: Every returned title and date; 24, 32 and 8 total results respectively. Full texts of unrelated later papers were not read.
sources.verdict: No later DDA title located in returned current author results.

sources.title: Current HAL API records
sources.read_scope: All returned metadata: one Nedaiasl record; six Costabel and eight Dauge records for the 2023-2026 queries. No PDF retrieved from HAL.
sources.verdict: Static v3 submitted 2023-10-22, metadata modified 2026-10-06; no new version or dynamic title located. Web challenge not bypassed.

sources.title: Publisher Crossref metadata/reference records
sources.read_scope: Metadata and exact Nedaiasl author matches among 100 ranked returned records; Hilbert dynamic reference inspected.
sources.verdict: Static version of record dated 2023-11-12; named dynamic entry in preparation. Actual publisher PDF inaccessible: HTML response instead.

sources.title: Forward citation indices
sources.read_scope: All returned citation metadata; two results each, with a three-item union.
sources.verdict: Incomplete and mutually different; discovery aids only.

sources.title: Ren et al. Axioms 2026 review
sources.read_scope: Publisher indexed text: introduction, foundations and static-paper citation location; not the full paper. Direct fetch returned HTTP 403.
sources.verdict: Screening finds neural integral-equation review; no exact DDA theorem in inspected passages. No full-paper clearance asserted.

sources.title: Goepfert 2024 ultrasound thesis
sources.read_scope: Primary HAL metadata and abstract only. Requested exact PDF yielded challenge HTML; no full text read.
sources.verdict: Coverage gap; no claim about the entirety of its mathematical proofs.
